title: Versammlungsgeschehen zu einem angezeigten Aufzug anlässlich des 10. Muharram

extraction.summaryEn: A registered Ashura march with about 600 participants at its peak went from Berliner Dom to Gendarmenmarkt in Mitte. A children's stage performance was stopped, several participants needed medical treatment for heat-related circulatory problems, and police reported no offences.
